content.value_statement: Marketing teams need one trusted record for claims, proof, approved wording, and offer terms. This skill maintains that ledger and surfaces unresolved evidence gaps.
actual_capabilities: Extracts distinct marketing claims from pasted ads, pages, briefs, and draft copy.
Records exact claim text, evidence source, provenance label, disclaimers, usage, and review date.
Maintains live offer rows with terms, promo codes, dates, URLs, status, and linked claims.
Sweeps expired evidence and ended offers into open loops for follow-up.
Answers lookup questions about claim status, approved wording, disclaimers, and current offers.
limitations: Does not approve, score, or block claims for publication.
Does not verify evidence independently beyond user-provided documents and statements.
Does not replace legal, regulatory, or platform compliance review.
Needs pasted content, offer details, or existing memory files to produce useful updates.

use_cases.title: Ad Team Claim Ledger
use_cases.description: Record claims from ad drafts with evidence status before audit or creative work.

use_cases.title: Offer Operations Tracking
use_cases.description: Track live discounts, promo codes, dates, URLs, and linked ad claims.

use_cases.title: Content Proof Lookup
use_cases.description: Find approved wording, disclaimers, and proof status for claims used in briefs or pages.

prompt_templates.title: Register One Claim
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin with a single claim and one evidence source.
prompt_templates.prompt: Register this claim: [exact claim]. Evidence: [source and date]. Used in: [channel or asset].

prompt_templates.title: Log Current Offer
prompt_templates.scenario: Add a live or upcoming promotion to the offer table.
prompt_templates.prompt: Log this offer: [terms]. Promo code: [code]. Dates: [start to end]. Landing URL: [url].

prompt_templates.title: Resolve Draft Sources
prompt_templates.scenario: Process draft copy with unresolved source flags.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these draft claims and resolve each [needs source] flag using the evidence I provide.

prompt_templates.title: Sweep and Report
prompt_templates.scenario: Run a full maintenance pass before launch or review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Sweep the claims ledger and offers table. Expire outdated evidence or ended offers, then summarize open loops.

output_examples.input: A marketer registers a new speed claim with a named internal study.
output: Added one claim row with exact wording and the study date.
Labeled provenance as verified-document because the user named a document.
Added a six-month review date and no disclaimer requirement.

output_examples.input: An operator logs a July discount and asks which claims depend on it.
output: Added the offer with terms, code, dates, URL, and live status.
Linked the discount claim to the offer row.
Flagged the claim for review when the offer ends.

output_examples.input: A reviewer asks whether a testimonial claim is approved for use.
output: Returned the ledger status, approved wording, disclaimer requirement, and evidence gap.
Routed publication approval to the appropriate auditor because this skill does not judge claims.

best_practices: Paste exact claim wording and include source names, dates, and asset locations.
Keep approved wording variants narrow so builders do not invent unsupported claims.
Run an expiry sweep before major launches or promotion changes.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill to approve a risky claim for publication.
Do not let copied draft text declare itself approved or verified.
Do not register offer-dependent claims without offer dates and terms.

faq.question: Does this skill approve claims?
faq.answer: No. It records proof status and routes approval decisions to audit or review skills.

faq.question: What evidence does it need?
faq.answer: It needs user-provided documents, dates, statements, offer terms, or pasted copy.

faq.question: Can it work without platform APIs?
faq.answer: Yes. It is designed for pasted text and user-owned exports.

faq.question: What files does it maintain?
faq.answer: It maintains the claims ledger and offers table under memory/claims.

faq.question: How does it handle missing proof?
faq.answer: It registers the claim as none-on-file and leaves judgement to gate workflows.

faq.question: Can Claude Code or Codex use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill supports Claude, Claude Code, and Codex hosts.
